site.name: SHIN-YU-MIN
site.tagline: Yuchi, Sun Moon Lake · Family Tea Makers
site.description: A family tea factory in Dayan Village, Yuchi Township, Nantou — the heart of the Sun Moon Lake black tea region. Best known for Ruby Black Tea (Taiwan Tea No. 18).

home.heroLead: Our factory is in Dayan Village, Yuchi Township, Nantou — the heart of the Sun Moon Lake black tea region. This is not a sourcing choice; it is where our family has lived and made tea for generations.
home.craftLead: Our black teas go from plucking to drying in our own factory in Dayan Village. We do not carry many teas, but each one is made properly.

craftSteps.name: Plucking
craftSteps.note: One bud, two leaves — picked only once the morning dew has lifted.

craftSteps.name: Withering
craftSteps.note: Spread indoors to lose water slowly. This is where the aroma wakes up.

craftSteps.name: Rolling
craftSteps.note: The leaf is bruised so its juices return to the surface.

craftSteps.name: Oxidation
craftSteps.note: The soul of black tea. When it is ready it is ready — not a moment early or late.

craftSteps.name: Drying
craftSteps.note: Heat takes the last water out and fixes the aroma in place.

home.featureNotes: Natural notes of cinnamon and mint — the signature character of the Ruby cultivar. A bright, clear red liquor with a sweet finish and no astringency.

story.title: Our Story
story.lead: Our factory is in Dayan Village, Yuchi Township, Nantou — the heart of the Sun Moon Lake black tea region. This is not a sourcing choice; it is where our family has lived and made tea for generations.
story.placeBody: Yuchi Township sits beside Sun Moon Lake. Its elevation, mist and soil make it one of the best black tea regions in Taiwan, and Dayan Village lies within it. Our address is where the tea is made and where we live — for us the origin is not a label, it is what we see when we open our eyes. Our leaf comes from growers we work with regularly, from gardens at around 750 metres. We pick five seasons a year, and the summer and autumn pickings carry the strongest aroma. Everything is hand-plucked.
story.cultivarBody: Ruby is a Taiwanese cultivar, bred from native wild Taiwan tea and Burmese large-leaf assamica, officially registered as Taiwan Tea No. 18. Its cinnamon and mint aroma comes from the cultivar itself — nothing is added. It is also why it holds up in milk: made into milk tea, the tea still speaks.
story.craftBody: For our black teas, plucking, withering, rolling, oxidation and drying all happen in our own factory, tended by hand. Oxidation is the soul of black tea: when it is ready it is ready, not a moment early or late. That is not something you can outsource; you have to stand there and watch it.
story.todayBody: We do not make many teas, but each one is made properly. For bulk orders, please call us — we will quote and arrange delivery separately.

sections.title: Dispatch times
body: Orders are dispatched within two working days. We do not dispatch on weekends or public holidays.
For bank transfer orders, the two days start from the day we confirm your payment.
Tea ships at ambient temperature; no refrigeration is needed.

sections.title: Where we ship
body: Taiwan's main island and outlying islands (Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu) only. We do not ship internationally.
We do not offer convenience-store pickup.

sections.title: Shipping fees
body: T-cat home delivery NT$ 200 / Post office NT$ 130 / Post office to outlying islands NT$ 250.
Free shipping on orders over NT$ 2,000 within the main island. Outlying islands are excluded.
For cash on delivery, the carrier's collection fee is charged separately and is not included in the amount shown on the website.

sections.title: When you can return an order
body: Under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act you have a seven-day review period after receiving your order. This is a period to inspect the goods, not a trial period.
If the packaging is unopened and intact, please call us within seven days of delivery and we will arrange the return.
If the goods are damaged in transit, they can be returned or refunded whether or not the package has been opened.

sections.title: When you cannot return an order
body: Tea is a food product. Once a vacuum pack is opened it cannot be restored to its original state, so for food safety reasons opened packages cannot be returned.
Please open the pack only once you are sure you want to keep the tea.

sections.title: Damaged parcels: please film the unboxing
body: If the parcel arrives crushed, torn or damp, please photograph it before opening and film the whole unboxing.
This is not us being difficult. Carriers require evidence that the damage happened in transit; without footage we cannot claim on your behalf.
Once you have the footage, please call us and we will arrange a return or a replacement.

sections.title: Who pays return postage
body: Defective or damaged goods: we pay.
Returns for other reasons (ordered the wrong thing, changed your mind): return postage is paid by the buyer.
If a parcel is returned or has to be resent because the delivery address was wrong, the additional postage is paid by the buyer.

sections.title: Changing or cancelling an order
body: There is no way to do this yourself on the website — please call us and we will sort it out.
Address, items and quantities can all be changed until the parcel is dispatched.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: What we collect
body: What you enter at checkout: name, phone number, email address, delivery address, and optionally a company tax ID, invoice title and a note.
We collect nothing else. There is no registration, no membership and no password on this website.

sections.title: Why we collect it
body: Name, phone and address: to ship your order and to contact you if there is a problem with it.
Email: to send your order confirmation.
Tax ID and invoice title: to issue an invoice. If you leave them blank they are never used.

sections.title: Where it is stored and who can see it
body: Order data is stored in a database provided by Supabase, hosted in Japan.
Order data is completely locked away from website visitors. The public website cannot read any order; only our password-protected admin can.
Only the family behind SHIN-YU-MIN sees your details. We never sell your data or pass it to marketing companies.

sections.title: External services we use
body: Supabase: stores product and order data.
Vercel: hosts the website.
LINE: when an order is placed, a notification containing the contact details needed for dispatch is sent to our own internal group, which only family members are in.
Resend: sends order confirmation emails (not yet enabled).
This website uses no AI services. What you type is never sent to an AI model.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
body: Your cart is stored in your own browser (LocalStorage); our server does not know what is in it.
There are no advertising trackers on this site, no cross-site behavioural tracking and no third-party ads.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Order records are retained as the basis for dispatch, accounting and tax records.
If you would like your contact details removed, please call us and we will handle it once we have confirmed who you are.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may ask us to show, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you. Please call us; we will confirm your identity and then act on it.

Why deletion needs a phone call rather than a button: this site has no user accounts, so we have no way to confirm online that the person pressing the button is really you. A self-service delete would mean anyone who guessed your order number could destroy your records. The phone call protects your data; it is not us being awkward.

Please also note that the amounts and items on completed orders are accounting records and must be retained for a period. Your contact details (phone, address, email) can be removed once we have confirmed who you are.
You can also check your own order status on this site using your order number and the last four digits of your phone number, without providing anything else.

privacy.contactNote: Requests to access, correct or delete personal data go to the person who looks after this website and its data. For orders, delivery and returns, please use the phone number in the footer instead.
